summary: TerminalGuard::enter installs a panic hook chained to the previous hook (std::panic::take_hook) that runs leave()'s restoration (show cursor, disable mouse capture, disable bracketed paste, leave alternate screen, disable raw mode, reclaim+restore saved termios) exactly once via the PANIC_RESTORE_PENDING AtomicBool shared with leave(); leave() reinstates the previous hook when not panicking. Debug-only ZENPI_DEBUG_PANIC_AFTER_START=1 panics right after terminal entry and then aborts (mirroring release panic=abort, so Drop never runs). New PTY smoke tools/tui_panic_restore_smoke.py verifies it.

notes: Smoke runs the TUI under /bin/sh as session leader so stty -a snapshots are taken on the live controlling tty (macOS revokes the slave after the leader exits). The kernel-managed PENDIN lflag is excluded from comparison because BSD sets it on every raw->canonical transition. Under unwinding (debug), the hook only restores for panics on the guard's owning thread so a caught worker-thread panic does not tear down a live TUI; under panic=abort any thread restores. original_terminal is now Option<Arc<TerminalState>> so the hook can share it.
